DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)

2751.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — The serpent’s tongue: Luring the Python out of its den ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count

description: Detects pip installing packages from an alternate index URL or find-links location that is not the official PyPI, matching the custom-repository hosting abuse described by Cisco Talos.

  - attack.t1059.006

description: Detects GET/POST requests to a PHP file under the iCagenda attachments or Balbooa Forms upload directories, indicating interaction with a planted web shell (CVE-2026-48939, CVE-2026-56291)
references:
  - https://mysites.guru/blog/icagenda-zero-day-file-upload-rce/
  - https://mysites.guru/blog/balbooa-forms-unauthenticated-file-upload-flaw/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/14
tags:
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_path:
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/images/icagenda/frontend/attachments/'
      - '/images/baforms/uploads/'
  selection_ext:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '.php'
  condition: selection_path and selection_ext
level: high
2826.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where (Web.uri_path="*/images/icagenda/frontend/attachments/*.php*" OR Web.uri_path="*/images/baforms/uploads/*.php*") by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.site, Web.http_method, Web.uri_path, Web.status, Web.http_user_agent | `drop_dm_object_name("Web")` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime

2827.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("mutations.js", "queries.js", "iphlpapi.dll", "setup.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("mutations.js", "queries.js", "iphlpapi.dll", "setup.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2827.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — jscrambler npm package publishes malicious preinstall binary ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("mutations.js","queries.js","iphlpapi.dll","setup.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("mutations.js","queries.js","iphlpapi.dll","setup.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2997.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — How We Added WebAuthn to a Browser-Based RDP Client
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("webauthn.dll", "mstsc.exe", "mstscax.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("webauthn.dll", "mstsc.exe", "mstscax.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2997.spl:

| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("webauthn.dll","mstsc.exe","mstscax.dll"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
